methodology: 3-point rubric (event type/table correct; comparison/direction not inverted; aggregation/grouping matches intent), scored against eval/results/rag_ab_raw.json. Rater 1 = primary session (Claude, with conversation context). Rater 2 = independent fresh-context agent given only the raw NL/ground_truth/generated KQL, no visibility into Rater 1's scores or reasoning.

summary.headline: Raters disagree on which condition wins in aggregate (rater1: RAG ahead 45-39; rater2: base ahead 48-45), despite substantial item-level ordinal agreement (quadratic-weighted kappa 0.70). Robust findings (both raters agree on direction): RAG meaningfully worse on dedb8fb9 (SonicWall SSH - drops outbound-direction filter and the port-OR-DPI disjunction); RAG meaningfully better on 01191239 (NXDOMAIN anomaly - correctly filters to NXDOMAIN before the series) and f82c89fa (IFEO registry - correctly filters to create+delete EventTypes) and 9b72769e (avoids an unrequested aggregation). Non-robust (raters disagree on direction): 50f0cdfb, 70e2a349, c6608467, 2d1a3e86.
